senses.zh: n.有意义的 重要的 意味深长的 相当数量的 重大的 n.(复)有意义的事物 标志

ex.en: The results of 10 million school students were examined over 13 years and researchers found a "significant" link between years with extremely hot weather and lower results.
"If predictions for the end of the century are true, though, I think a lot of agricultural areas in the US will see significant hits."

col: a significant glance｜意味深长的一瞥
tip: 统计上significant指达到显著性标准，不等于实际影响很大。

sourceRows.zh: n.有意义的 重要的 意味深长的 相当数量的 重大的 n.(复)有意义的事物 标志

senses.zh: n.沉默 寂静 vt.使沉默 使安静

ex.en: We sat in silence as the snow fell outside.
ex.zh: 外面下着雪，我们静静地坐着。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

ex.en: Extended periods of silence in classrooms can give students valuable time to reflect on difficult questions.
ex.zh: 课堂上较长的安静时段可以给学生宝贵的时间来思考难题。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

tip: in silence意为默默地；silent是形容词。

sourceRows.zh: n.沉默 寂静 vt.使沉默 使安静

senses.zh: adj.沉默的 寂静无声的 安静的 不吵闹的 无言的 n.(复数)默剧

ex.en: Guests would fall silent in wonder as servants carried Carême's fancy creations into the dining hall.
He recommends that we don't stay silent over inappropriate behaviour, particularly with regular visitors.

tip: silent强调不出声；quiet也可表示声音很小。

sourceRows.zh: adj.沉默的 寂静无声的 安静的 不吵闹的 无言的 n.(复数)默剧

senses.zh: n.蚕丝 丝 绸 丝织品 adj.丝的

ex.en: The silk ribbon would stop the lightning from passing through his body.

tip: silk通常不可数；silky指柔滑如丝，不一定是丝制。

sourceRows.zh: n.蚕丝 丝 绸 丝织品 adj.丝的

senses.zh: adj.傻的 愚蠢的 淳朴的 晕的

ex.en: Intelligent people are more prone to silly mistakes because of blind spots in how they use logic.
"Play is not silly behavior," the academy's report declares.

tip: 语气通常比stupid轻，也可表示逗趣、不正经。

sourceRows.zh: adj.傻的 愚蠢的 淳朴的 晕的

senses.zh: n.银 银子 银器 adj.银色的 银的 vt.镀银 变成银白色

ex.en: I love the colonial fabrics, all the silver work, the furnishings, the combination of elegance and simplicity.
The snake has been named Silver Boa because it is metal-coloured and the first specimen found was climbing a silver palm tree.

tip: 表示金属银时不可数；a silver可指一枚银牌。

sourceRows.zh: n.银 银子 银器 adj.银色的 银的 vt.镀银 变成银白色

senses.zh: adj.相似的 类似的 同样的

ex.en: According to Foulkes, "Children's dream life…seems to be similar to their waking imagination and narration."
The fierce divide between store owners and bike-lane advocates seems similar to our larger culture wars over climate change.

tip: 用similar to，不用similar with；相似不等于相同。

sourceRows.zh: adj.相似的 类似的 同样的

senses.zh: adv.类似地 相似地

ex.en: Similarly, nutrition research sponsored by the food industry is more likely to end up favoring the food under consideration than independently funded research.
Similarly, using Airbnb or a car-hire service for the first time encourages people to try other offerings.

tip: 句首Similarly常接逗号，用于引出相似情况。

sourceRows.zh: adv.类似地 相似地

senses.zh: adj.简单的 朴素的 无辜的 天真的 基本的 纯粹的 n.平民 精神病人 草药

ex.en: As online courses tend to have more than 100 students, most of the assignments are short and simple.
Taking whatever materials are handy and tinkering with them is a simple way to engage those important "maker" skills.

tip: simple可指容易或朴素，不一定表示简陋。

sourceRows.zh: adj.简单的 朴素的 无辜的 天真的 基本的 纯粹的 n.平民 精神病人 草药

senses.zh: n.简单 简易 朴素 单纯 简朴

ex.en: Over the years this system has come in for its share of criticism for its simplicity.
I love the colonial fabrics, all the silver work, the furnishings, the combination of elegance and simplicity.

tip: simplicity通常不可数；simple的名词形式。

sourceRows.zh: n.简单 简易 朴素 单纯 简朴

senses.zh: vt.简化 使单纯

ex.en: Clearly, there are plenty of ways to keep track of your job search and making the effort to simplify your job search will pay off.

col: simplify an explanation｜使解释更易懂
tip: simplify强调减少复杂性；simple是形容词。

sourceRows.zh: vt.简化 使单纯

senses.zh: adv.简单地 朴素地 仅仅 完全地

ex.en: Simply "feeling" that something is right or should be done is highly subjective and can drown you.
Without understanding, we risk dehumanizing others, writing off human beings simply because we don't comprehend them.

tip: simply可表示“仅仅”，不一定表示“简单地”。

sourceRows.zh: adv.简单地 朴素地 仅仅 完全地

senses.zh: n.罪 罪孽 过失 vi.犯罪 违反

ex.en: He believed that lying to his friends was a sin.
ex.zh: 他认为对朋友撒谎是一种罪过。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

ex.en: Ideas about sin can influence social attitudes, even in societies where religious participation is declining.
ex.zh: 即使在宗教参与度下降的社会，对罪的观念也可能影响社会态度。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

tip: 侧重宗教或道德上的罪，不等于法律上的crime。

sourceRows.zh: n.罪 罪孽 过失 vi.犯罪 违反

senses.zh: conj.从...以来 因为 既然 自从 adv.后来 prep.自从

ex.en: Mr. Fong has been involved in the organization since he was 15 and began teaching lion dancing three years ago.
"We started Design Ventura with around 800 young people in 2010 and it has grown steadily since," she says.

tip: 表时间时，since接起点，for接时长。
